admission_process.title: AISECT University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: AISECT University admissionis both merit and entrance-based. The university offers conducts entrance test and/ or group discussion and interview/ direct admission to offer admission to candidates.AISECT University conducts the AJEE exam to shortlist candidates for admission in various programmes offered by the varsity.AISECT Universityoffers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in multiple streams such as Management, Commerce, Computer Application, etc. Interested candidates can apply online for the preferred course.

AISECT offers admission to candidates either based on their merit or entrance exam score. Candidates also need to fulfil the course-specific eligibility criteria to get admission. Below are theAISECT University coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Download:AISECT Prospectus
AISECT University admission process includes registration, selection and fee payment. Below are the steps to get a seat in the university:
STEP 1: AISECT Application Process 2025

Aspirants can apply online or download the application form. Aspirants need to pay an application fee of INR 400 for each course. Candidates can pay the application fee in cash or DD or via any of the online payment modes.
STEP 2: Selection

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria for AISECT University, Jharkhand admissions are informed about the date, time and venue of admission procedure (written test and/or group discussion and interview/direct admission) on the official website of the University.

All candidates need to appear forAJEE examto secure admission at AISECT University, Jharkhand. In case direct admission is offered in any course, the same would be carried out basis the merit list prepared as per the application forms received. For all the courses offered by the university, the admission notice will appear in the daily national newspaper/university website/notice board or any other publicity media.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LLB. - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied with faculty and staff. Main thing is that parking facility is not there.

content.Placements: Placements were not so good. 30 to 35 percent of students were placed. The highest package was Rs 40,000, and minimum was Rs 8,000. Its very difficult to survive in life after taking a degree from this college because the education system was very bad. Placements were very low, and students were facing a lot of problems there.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of college campus was good. Hostel was not so good, it was in bad condition. The rooms in the hostel were so small. There was no place to park vehicles inside the college, and vehicles were also not allowed to enter the college. There was no facility for auto inside college so students faced many problems.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Adarsh Mahila Mahavidyalaya.

content.Placements: As per the B.A. degree, relatively expected placements are low, as most students opt for higher education, or they prefer professional courses. The average package ranges from 3-5 LPA. The top companies that recruit students are generally local companies in the city. Approximately 30-35% of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has a Wi-Fi facility and well-made labs. Classrooms are big and well-accommodated. The library is well-stocked with books and highly resourceful. The hostel food is good. The college campus has a canteen, and it is the best thing. There is a full garden, and the college is surrounded by greenery all around.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: In my opinion, students should not take admission to this college.

content.Placements: None of the students get placed in our course so if students are searching for placements then they should not come to this college. If there is no placement then there will be no package and there will be no companies too. No companies will come to provide internships. Top roles are not offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is only okay and not so good at our college. There is Wi-Fi in our college, but the Wi-Fi doesn't have high speed. Classrooms do not have AC and the library doesn't have silence in it. Hostels are bad too like class and fans don't work properly in it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: All things are good, but placements are too slow.

content.Placements: Companies for internships as well as placements are coming to select candidates. However, the process has been affected in the past year due to changes in the placement officer. Now, the new placement officer is working too fast to provide good placement opportunities for students enrolled in this course.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel has good infrastructure and a good environment, with each student having their room. Facilities such as proper drinking RO water are available at all times. Proper facilities of hygienic bathrooms and toilets are provided here. Proper care of students is maintained here.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: There are no placements, and you should not take admission to this college.

content.Placements: The placement scene at our college is really disappointing. There are zero campus placements and no help with finding internships. The placement cell doesn't do much and students are left to figure things out on their own. It's frustrating especially when you expect some support for your career from the college, and they don't provide any placements or internships.
content.Infrastructure: The food in our mess is just terrible, tasteless, oily, and the same boring stuff every day. Half the time, it's not even fresh. Eating here feels like a punishment. The infrastructure is average. Hostels don't have AC for the summer, making them feel like the worst.

hostel_campus.college_name: Vasireddy Venkatadri International Technological University Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with placements and dissatisfied with faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the building infrastructure is very good and disciplined to see. It has poor network, average classrooms, and excellent library. Quality of food is good. Sports and games preference are very low. Maintenance of canteen service is very perfect and obedient.

reviews.review_heading: Compared to other colleges, it is somewhat better.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are available for our course/department. A lab is provided only during exam time, and students carry their own laptops. Classrooms are good, and library is also good. The quality of the facilities in our hostel, medical facilities, and sports are too nice.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vasireddy Venkatadri Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in classrooms from the 3rd year. There are 2 hostels for girls and they are within the campus. Each room has 4 beds with attached washrooms and an air-conditioner. Each floor will have a geyser and washing area.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty, strong placements, and vibrant campus life at VVIT.
reviews.review_text: VVIT has excellent infrastructure with advanced computer labs, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, and a well-stocked library. Hostels are clean and comfortable with 24/7 power and water. Mess food is hygienic and tasty. Medical care is available, and sports and cultural facilities are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very nice and very disciplined.
reviews.review_text: When it comes to facilities and infrastructure, the mechanical department is good. The department has a library and very big classrooms, and every floor has a Wi-Fi setup. The quality of food is very good, and we have emergency vehicles also. We have the best sports department as well.

reviews.review_heading: A bit dissatisfied because of the placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is rarely available. Labs, classrooms, and library are okay. Hostel is nice, air-conditioned, and located on the campus for girls. Food is also tasty. No high medical facilities, quality is 4.5 out of 5. Sports and games are available like cricket, basketball, and also NSS, NCC.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Vasireddy Venkatadri International Technological University.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is very nice and has superb rooms. We have beautiful late nights on campus. We have the best classrooms and Wi-Fi is available. We have so many labs, and one library is there. The food is not bad and somewhat good. We have two canteens and a small medical clinic. We have sports for a day and an hour.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good environment and friendly faculty members.
reviews.review_text: They have all the infrastructure for this course and also individual lab charges. The hostel facility is also good for both girls and boys. Coming to the food, it is very good. They serve good quality food. Coming to the sports, it is a good college for the sports person, they will encourage them.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for B.Tech students to build their careers.
reviews.review_text: It is located near the Kaza Toll Plaza. It is well-lit and properly ventilated, with 25 rooms, 10 beds, a bathroom attached, and ample study space. There is a dedicated mess that serves healthy and hygienic food. The fee is Rs 95,000 for the academic year 2024-25, including transport. There are 24-hour vigilant security services. Students have to opt for the bus service in the morning and evening from the hostel and the college as well.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely, the college is good, the infrastructure is great, and the management is supportive.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, and the environment is full of grass and trees around the college. There are 6 to 7 blocks in the college, and the quality of facilities in the hostel is good. The food in the mess is also great, and the canteen provides good food at good prices.

reviews.review_heading: Absolute discipline and education.
reviews.review_text: We have good Wi-Fi, excellent labs, average classrooms, and a good library. Air conditioning is available, along with quality food and snacks. Our canteen offers nice options, and we have well-maintained grounds and facilities. My college provides a variety of amenities and solid infrastructure, with well-designed rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are better but students require perfect training with great faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure has been continuously developing in recent times because there is no control over the strength of students that's a quick problem to resolve or manage. Hostel facilities are too good with hygienic food and excellent taste. The price of hostel is much expensive when compared to other colleges, but worth it.

reviews.review_heading: A honest review by a truthful student.
reviews.review_text: Classes are quite large, but they don't have proper ventilation facilities for civil engineering students. Wi-Fi is not available, computers in library are not working, etc. As far as I know about the hostel, there are no good comfort facilities, and food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: This is the place to settle in our life successfully.
reviews.review_text:
In my college there are more advanced labs and most beautiful case rooms and peaceful library. My college faculty vis most experience and talented faculty are there. In hostel food are very tasty and healthy food is available and medical facilities are quickly supported there is ambulance are available in my college. There is a 10 acres of play ground is available 
.

reviews.review_heading: VVIT: Absolute discipline and education.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are top-most. All classrooms are air-conditioned. The food is very tasty and like home food. Infrastructure of college is good. Labs are also very well constructed and we have nearly 30 clubs from where we can gain skills.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bishop Jerome Institute.
reviews.review_text: Our college has classrooms, a seminar hall, a lab, a robotics lab, a library, a hostel, and a playground. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The quality of the hostel is good. Our college is safe for girls.

reviews.review_heading: I am happy with the faculty, but the college is a bit strict.

reviews.review_heading: It provides good results in sports and extra curriculum activities.

Martin Luther Christian University was founded in 2005. It is a private university and is located in Shillong, Meghalaya. Martin Luther Christian University courses are offered to students at the UG, PG and Certificate levels. The institute offers courses in Full Time mode. Martin Luther Christian University offers a total of 54 courses in streams such as Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce, Arts ( Fine / Visual / Performing ) and Humanities & Social Sciences. Some of the popular courses offered at the institute are MBA/PGDM, B.Sc., M.Sc., MCA and BCA. These courses are offered to students across several specialisations such as Counseling, English, Entrepreneurship, Environmental Geography and Environmental Sciences. Further, the fee for all these courses ranges between INR 3,250 to 4,36,100. Apart from this, the Martin Luther Christian University campus has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with all the advanced facilities.

review_content.Placements: Good internship opportunities are provided to students; contacts of different companies are arranged, and internships in different companies are provided to students with good stipends. admission_process.title: HGPI Sirmour Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Himalayan Group of Professional Institutions admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The university accepts national or state-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, HPCET, HPU MAT, etc. for admission to specific courses. HGPI offers more than 15 courses at UG, PG and diploma levels through seven institutes. The courses are offered in multiple streams such as Management, Pharmacy, Computer Applications, Engineering, etc. Interested candidates can apply forHGPI Sirmouradmissions online.

Himalayan Group of Professional Institutions offers courses in full-time mode. Candidates can apply for the course of their choice by filling out the application form. Below are theHGPI admissionhighlights:
Particulars
HGPI Sirmour Admission Highlights 2025
Mode of study
Programmes Offered
Admission status 2025
Ongoing:UG, PG & Diploma
How to apply?
https://hgpi.in/

Popular programmes

Candidates can get admission to most of the courses based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. The institute accepts entrance exams for admission to courses such as BTech, MBA, MPharm, etc. Below are popularHGPI coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Class 12 in relevant subjects with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate for reserved category)
The minimum aggregate required is at least 55% aggregate (50% aggregate for SC/ ST) for admission without entrance test

HGPI admission process includes steps such as registration, selection and admission confirmation. Eligible candidates must first apply for the course of their choice. Below are the steps to get a seat in HGPI:
Step 1: HGPI Application Process 2025
Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online on the official website of HGPI. Aspirants need to pay an application fee to register for a course.
Step 2: Selection

The institute shortlists candidates for most of the programmes based on merit in the last qualifying exam. The institute accepts national or state-level entrance exams such as HPU MAT, HPCET, CAT, JEE Main, etc, for admission to specific programmes. Candidates fulfilling the criteria for direct admission will be directly called for document verification.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation

Once the selection process is over, aspirants may need to fill out the admission form. Selected aspirants are called for document verification and counselling. HGPI also offers seats under the Management Quota. Selected candidates need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

admission_process.title: CMR Engineering College Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: CMR Engineering College admission 2025is a mix of merit and entrance-based. Students need to satisfy the admission criteria set by the college to get into the desired programme. Students can pursue undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programmes in the field of Engineering and Technology.CMR Engineering Collegeaccepts applications on the basis of a state-level entrance exam followed by counselling. However, direct admissions are also provided. The admission process mainly commences online. Interested students can read the following article to know about the courses, eligibility, selection, criteria, and other admission-related information for CMR Engineering College.

CMR Engineering College course admissionis made on the basis of clearance of the preset admission criteria. The college offers BTech, MTech, and PhD programmes in full-time and regular mode. Students looking to get into the college must ensure that they satisfy the eligibility before applying. Further, the college also reserves a certain amount of seat intake for the management quota. Find below the eligibility and selection criteria for popularCMR Engineering College courses:
Graduation degree in Engineering/Technology OR AMIE/AMIETE or similar qualifications recognised by UPSC as equivalent to B.E./BTech

The admission process for CMR Engineering College includes multiple steps, such as application, shortlisting, and admission confirmation. As admissions are primarily entrance-based, students are required to clear the accepted exam and participate in the counselling process for seat allotment. Interested students can follow the steps explained below to completeCMR Engineering College admission procedure:
Step 1: Application Process

Students applying through the Convenor quota can visit the official website of the concerned entrance exam and fill out the application form. At the time of counselling, students need to provide the counselling code of the institute. Further, those looking to get into the college under management quota may reach out to the college for applications.
Step 2: Selection

The college offers 70% of the total seat intake for Convenor quota students. Such candidates have to clear the accepted entrance exam and participate in the counselling process for seat allotment. The remaining 30% of seats are offered through management quota. Students must have secured a valid score in TS EAMCET and GATE/ TSICET for BTech and MTech admissions respectively.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation

Once an admission offer is made, students need to report at the college and go through document verification. For final seat confirmation, students must payCMR Engineering College feesas prescribed by the college.

It has one big library having many books of different courses and some other books with the facility of a digital library system. Many labs are having good systems and workshops for the students. The food quality and taste are very good. But the sports facility in our college is not that good. Wi-Fi is available for all the students studying in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Institute of Management and Technology, Faridabad.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi is available with 1 GB data per day per person.
Classes are quite good with multiple windows for air. The campus is surrounded by plants. A well-maintained library is available. A canteen is available with all food items.

reviews.review_heading: This college has remarkable beauty.
reviews.review_text: It has a good and hygienic canteen for students and teachers. I also volunteer it. The Wi-Fi, library, canteen, a ground are provided. Our college get various facilities as I mentioned above. It also organised various competitions like dance, singing, gaming, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is better, and there are some very good facilities. A few are not much good. We have good parks and a better library. Many sports and games are conducted at both district-level and state-level.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students.
reviews.review_text: IMT college has a broad infrastructure of the college. Most of the good facilities are provided to students. We play sports and games at district and state levels. The canteen on the campus is good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college conducts some games from time to time. Our college offers a good environment. Our college has a good building. Our college provides good classrooms with a projector facility and a camera. Our college has a good library. Our college also provides all facilities related to food like canteen, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a good and attractive environment.
reviews.review_text: This college has a good infrastructure, and they are giving most of the valuable facilities to the students. The college has an attractive environment, and a good source of books is available in the library of our college. There is also a canteen where students can get food at valuable prices.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good at infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is average. There is a garden, and there is a book library. The facility of water cooler is also available on every floor of the college campus. Playground and some sports facilities are also provided on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: IMT is a better college to pursue higher education.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good infrastructure. There is an auditorium in which the college arranges important programmes. There is a library, and classrooms are very good with projector facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Mostly, our college is good in every aspect.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available here with good infrastructure, but there is no hostel. Sports are not much appreciated because faculty members focus more on the studies. The canteen serves hygiene food, and medical facilities are also available. But the library can provide you with the syllabus books only and not references.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is not that good. It has an old building which is painted, and it is fine. There are medical facilities available but never seen where it is provided and never seen any student availing it. Sports facilities are also available here, but the park is not good. We have to get our own sports equipment as the college does not provide any equipment.

reviews.review_heading: An average college with low fees.
reviews.review_text: The location of the college is good. We have a three-storey academic building, and it contains around 150 classrooms. There is a separate library available for management students. However, the computer lab is shared with the BCA department. Our classrooms are air-conditioned. Sports activities are also organised here. The canteen facility is very poor. The hostel is located too far from our campus.

reviews.review_heading: Our college consist of good faulty and efficient Infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure facilities in our college is to good and efficient it includes good computer lab and efficient library which contains all books which we needed in college and daily news paper and also business magazines. Classroom are with efficient furniture and well seating arrangement. There is no hostel of our college. Canteen of our college is very good which provides us healthy food and cleanliness.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college in Faridabad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. There is Wi-Fi facility. There are good labs, and the classrooms are big. The library is excellent with a quiet environment. The medical facilities are average. Sports and games are always done at regular intervals. The food available in the canteen is under budget for students and are of good quality and hygiene. Hostel facilities are provided which is also good. I didn't face any infrastructure related issues during my tenure at the college.

overview_faqs.question: What is the average BTech Computer Science Engineering salary in India?
overview_faqs.answer: The average BTech CSE salary for graduates in India can range between INR 4 LPA and INR 12 LPA. The scope of the BTech CSE programme in India is excellent and hence the starting salary packages offered by recruiters are also high as compared to some other engineering courses.The salary depends on factors like the years of experience you hold, your academic qualification, skill set, etc. Once you enter the industry and get some years of experience in hand, you will get a higher salary package. But, in the starting of your career journey, you can expect between INR 4 LPA and INR 6 LPA.

admission_process.title: Khallikote University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Khallikote University offersseven postgraduate programmessuch as MSc Biosciences and Bioinformatics, MSc Biotechnology, MA/ MSc Natural Resources Management and Geoinformatics, MA Library and Information Science, MBA Business Economics, MBA Travel and Tourism Management and MA Mass Communication and Media Technology across six departments, namely Department of Bioscience and Bioinformatics, Department of Natural Resources Management and Geoinformatics, Department of Library and Information Science, Department of Economics and Management, Department of Travel, Tourism and Hospitality Management and Department of Mass Communication and Media Technology. Admission to all the courses offered by Khallikote University Berhampur is entrance-based.

For admission toDBT sponsored MSc Biotechnology programme, students have to qualify for GAT-B (previouslyJNUCEEB) while applicants have to qualify for the Central Universities Common Entrance Test (CUCET) and Odisha State Universities Common PG Entrance Test (CPET) through the Student Academic Management System (SAMS), Odisha for admission to rest of the six programmes. For MBA,OJEE/CAT/MATscores are also considered in case of vacant seats. The university also offersfull-time PhD programmesin Biosciences/ Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Natural Resource Management, Environmental Science, Geoinformatics, Economics; Management, Commerce and Library and Information Science.
Khallikote University offers PG and PhD courses. The duration of these programmes varies from course to course. A quick snapshot of Khallikote University admission 2025 is given below:

BSc (Physics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology) with 50% aggregate OR Honours with Biology in Class 12 OR professional courses (BTech/ BE/ MBBS/ BPharm/ BHMS) + CUCET/ CPET (SAMS Odisha)

BSc Agricultural Science/ Marine Science & Oceanography/ Marine Engineering/ Botany/ Chemistry/ Environmental Engineering/ Environmental Science/ Geology/ Physics/ Zoology/ Forestry/ Mirco-biology/ Geography/ Mathematics with a minimum of 45% aggregate + CUCET/ CPET (SAMS Odisha)

Graduation with 50% aggregate OR Graduate in Arts (Library Science as Core/ Hons/ Elective) with 45% aggregate OR B.Lib/ B.Lib & Inf. Sc. (one-year course after Graduation) with 45% aggregate + CUCET/ CPET (SAMS Odisha)
Graduation with 45% aggregate (Hons) + CUCET/ CPET (SAMS Odisha)
Graduation with 50% aggregate (Hons) + CUCET/ CPET (SAMS Odisha)/ OJEE/ CAT/ MAT
Graduation with 50% aggregate (Hons) + CUCET/ CPET (SAMS Odisha)/ OJEE/ CAT/ MAT

Note:The total fee has been taken from Khallikote University Prospectus 2020-21. The detailed criteria for career evaluation is as under:
(Total marks secured / Maximum marks) x 5
(Total marks secured / maximum marks) x 10
Graduation (Aggregate)

Graduate (Honours)

Distinction in graduation

Note:In case of identical total marks in (entrance + career), entrance marks will be taken for deciding merit. If entrance marks are also identical, then career marks in graduation examination (+3) and then +2 marks will be considered for deciding rank, respectively. In case, of +2 career marks being identical, the applicant born earlier will get the higher rank.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for MBA and what is the minimum OJEE percentile required?
faqs.answer: Registration, choice filling, seat allotment list, document verification, and admission confirmation are all part of the MBA selection process at Khallikote University.The following are the minimum requirements for OJEE:Passing a minimum three-year Diploma exam with a grade point average of at least 45%40% for candidates from the reserved categoriesRegistration, choice filling, seat allotment list, document verification, and admission confirmation are all part of the OJEE counseling process.The OJEE counseling fee is INR 450. Selected candidates must pay a seat confirmation fee of INR 10,000 or 5000 depending on their category.

faqs.question: Are admissions at Khallikote University entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Admission to Khallikote University is competitive. Candidates must have a Bachelor's degree from a recognised university in any relevant discipline with a minimum of 50% marks. The Central Universities Common Entrance Test (CUCET) and Odisha State Universities Common Entrance Test (OSUCET) scores are used in the selection process. For any remaining vacant seats, a valid OJEE / CAT / XAT / MAT score will be considered.

faqs.question: Is Khallikote University hard to get?
faqs.answer: Admission to Khallikote Unitary University is not very difficult if the candidates meet the basic eligibility criteria. The University offers admission based on merit, wherein, candidates require to achieve minimum aggregate in Class 12 or graduation, depending on the level of course opted for. For UG level courses, candidates must secure a minimum aggregate inClass 12along with suggested subjects, whereas, for PG level courses, candidates must qualifygraduationwith a minimum aggregate of45%to50%. Apart from this, candidates must secure valid scores in the accepted entrance exams such as Orissa SAMS, OJEE, MAT, CAT, XAT and others.

reviews_list.review_title: MCA is the best course in this college.

review_content.Placements: About 77 percent of our students were placed. The lowest salary in our study is 6 LPA, the highest is 21 LPA, and the average is 12 LPA. Some of the top recruiters include Dell Technologies, HCL Technologies, and Mahindra & Mahindra, among others. Web developer, designer, and other top positions are offered to the students. More than 70 percent of the participants in our study were referred to internships. It is a really wonderful college all around.
review_content.Infrastructure: The institution includes charging outlets, Wi-Fi in the library, digital learning, projector-based learning, and a digital library. The restaurant’s food is consistently innovative and fresh, despite the lack of a hostel. There is also a medical room and a medical aid box, and the restrooms are hygienic. Additionally, the college has facilities specifically designed for sports and athletics.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: My honest review of my college.

review_content.Placements: As far as placements go, the TPO arranges quite a lot of aptitude tests to secure a place for the interview rounds for different companies. Certain club members, like Share, provide the opportunity to give interviews for companies related to the field of the club.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are limited seats in the hostel on campus. I can speak only about girls' hostel. Rooms are pretty good with good beds and cupboards. There are windows in every room, and my room has the most amazing view. Hostels on campus are quite expensive, and the local accommodation would be cheaper.

reviews.review_heading: College building is very mesmerising and has maintained discipline inside the campus.
reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar, but I have little information about hostel infrastructure. I heard that hostels are well structured and have every possible facility that is required for any student. Food, including the medical facility, the mess is also well hygienic and has a good quality of food.

reviews.review_heading: Khalsa College Amritsar review .
reviews.review_text: It has all the necessary infrastructure for labs, classrooms, etc. Classrooms have proper ventilation facilities, and I love the library. Parking facilities are also good, and there are boys and girls' hostels. Good mess facilities, proper and tasty food, and proper healthcare for students are provided.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty and placement rate attract students the most.
reviews.review_text: Our faculty has the most famous infrastructure among colleges in the state. Our buildings' infrastructure is traditionally designed. We have well-organized libraries and labs. Hostels are well maintained by the staff and offer good quality food. Also, there are large grounds available for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the staff, but teachers in admissions cell are a little rude.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of college is quite good. There are more than 5 computer labs, the students get proper guidance on how to practice on their personal computers. Library is quite big and has all sorts of books. Moreover, the hostel facilities are proper, and the food and rooms are clean.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, education, and different departments to explore and learn.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is good but it could be better in some departments. Overall, the building of the college is too attractive for different people from different places. It makes good inspiration for others. It gives a better place to study and learn.

reviews.review_heading: I like college ambiance, infrastructure, and education, but fees are too expensive.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually very good, and there are many canteens available. The library is also good and peaceful. The library and laboratories are well-equipped. Medical facilities are available. The college provides good services.

reviews.review_heading: I have a good experience in our college because it provides good facilities and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Many infrastructure facilities are available, such as a library, classrooms with projectors, and labs. The quality of the facilities in our college hostel is also good. Food is served on time, and students enjoy different kinds of food on weekends.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and facilities are above expectations.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure of the college is phenomenal.
It's spread over 330 acres and is very developed.
There are different canteens for different departments.
The classrooms are ventilated.
The building itself looks very beautiful (old money type).
Each department has its own library, and the main library is one of the biggest in the state itself.

reviews.review_heading: Khalsa College Amritsar -a yes or no
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very huge and attractive. Many movies have been recorder here because of its beautiful building. There are more than 7 hostels in college. The quality of food is 7/10. There is a great focus on  sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: Khalsa College Amritsar =a yes or no
reviews.review_text: There is wifi  provided in some hostels in campus but some do not provide it , as there are more than 6 hostel inside  college. Hostel food is around 8/10. Infrastructure is around 7/10. Nothing can beat our own house. Also medical facilities are not very good.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with my college, the best college of Amritsar and Punjab and connectivity of students.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in class includes tables and green board. Whole class is facilitated with fans and ventilated windows. Every floor has washrooms and drinking water supply. Hostel has many facilities like Wi-Fil mess, tables, garden etc. Hostel fees is affordable .

reviews.review_heading: Review of Khalsa College Amritsar.
reviews.review_text: Actually, I don't live in a hostel, but many of my friends live in hostels; they say that the mess's food is really awesome. And the rooms are big enough for two people. The beds that are provided are soft, and electricity is always available in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of good infrastructure and college’s value.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good. The classrooms are well maintained and the library offers a nice space for studying. There is no Wi-Fi in the hostel which can be inconvenient. The food in the mess is just okay. Medical and sports facilities are  quite good.

reviews.review_heading: B.Com (Hons) in Khalsa College .
reviews.review_text: The college has built a new department for commerce and business administration. The department has its own library where all types of economic and business-related newspapers and magazines are also available, along with all types of books. Well-cleaned washrooms are on every floor. The hostel facilities for both boys and girls are available. The food at mess is of great quality and tasty. The charges are also very reasonable.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, helpful and well qualified teachers.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities are well-built, and the mess food is good. The labs, classes, and canteen are well-maintained. There are many opportunities for sports players, and the medical facilities are good. The canteen provides good food at genuine prices. Overall, it's a good college.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely satisfying because of the ambiance and pleasant nature.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for all courses and departments are good. We have Wi-Fi, AC labs, and well-versed classrooms. The library is pleasant on our campus, with thousands of books. The hostel and canteen facilities are well managed.

reviews.review_heading: Placements and faculty is good.
reviews.review_text: Our college is equipped with many facilities, like Wi-Fi for labs, digital classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Coming to the hostel facility, the food is very healthy and hygienic. It is served in the mess and canteen. They encourage sports like cricket and volleyball.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college and its faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is good. Our college has two building blocks. In the EEE department, we have separate labs, and in our college, we have a big library. All books are available there. The hostel's facilities are good. In the mess, the food quality is also good. Our college has multiple sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was very good. Classrooms were well-maintained. Computer laboratories were better. There was a decent library in this college. Our campus was Wi-Fi enabled. Playground was available. Separate hostels were available for both boys and girls. The security facility was very good on campus.

reviews.review_heading: College has really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text:
All the students have access to spacious rooms. Each room has a bathroom with round-the-clock running water.
Good-quality food is the priority of the hostel, and only branded commodities are used for preparation.
A number of social events, such as New Year's Eve, Holi, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied because the faculty was not so experienced and better placements.
reviews.review_text: Despite having the lush green campus our college has no Wi-Fi during campus but restricted to some areas and classrooms are okay. Library plays a crucial role in my college having a no of journals and other books. Canteen was very average when I was studying and the medical facilities were pretty average. My branch doesn't allows us to play games despite the college having giant play grounds.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Datta Institute of Engineering and Science.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is available but it charges high fees and outside hostels are at very low rates with Wi-Fi. The quality of food served in the hostel is not very good. Mess and canteen are available in our college. Sports are conducted every year.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college.
reviews.review_text: We have the best study rooms and books in the library. Free unlimited Wi-Fi for us is available. Food is always good, but sometimes we adjust. The ground is the best and very big, and it is free to play and even for the time pass. Also, first kits are always ready for the emergency, and hospitals are near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Compared from 2015 to 2020, our college is a little bit better now.
reviews.review_text: We are provided with lab sessions daily, and our college provided the perfect teaching, library, etc. The quality of the facilities provided in our hostel was very good and very genuine. Quality food is available in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities are available, and sports and games are conducted only on weekends. It is mandatory for students to wear dress code.

reviews.review_heading: Very much satisfied with the peaceful environment.
reviews.review_text: Every lab and library of the college has Wi-Fi facility. They provide it to students. In hostel, it has the best environment and good quality of food with different menu each day. They conduct many competitions for hostellers during each festival.

reviews.review_heading: Adhiparasakthi engineering college.
reviews.review_text: There are good hostel facilities with all the needed things. All medical emergencies are available within our college campus. They are also very strict about following the dress code. Both teachers and students are asked to wear uniforms when necessary.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and placements in 2023.
reviews.review_text:
The building has good infrastructure and the main building is too good. The place is very quiet and easy to learn. 
Wi-Fi is available in the lab office room and the class room is a good place to learn.
First aid is available and ambulances are available all the time at the college entrance.

reviews.review_heading: A college that parents must avoid.
reviews.review_text: The good thing about this college is the infrastructure. The labs are huge and can handle loads of students at once. We've got Wi-Fi, but there's no luck in getting anything done online as our laptops are always under scrutiny with many of the websites, including the educational ones, being blocked. The classrooms are nice, big, and bright. The library is massive and probably one of the biggest around. But barely anyone bothers to use it properly as most students are asked to focus on passing ex...

reviews.review_heading: Adhiparasakthi Engineering College is really the best college.
reviews.review_text: This college has good infrastructure facilities. This college offers a wider range of courses. More mechanical and civil laboratories are also here at this college. This college also has medical facilities. This college hostel is maintained very cleanly. Mess foods are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Adhiparasakthi Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college was good. Labs and classrooms were neat, hygienic, and clean. The hostel food provided was tasty and healthy. We had non-vegetarian food once a week.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Adhiparasakthi Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: In this college, Wi-Fi, canteen, and projector are available. The food served in the hostel is good. The rooms are also good. The ground for sports facilities is also available. Hospital has many facilities 24X7. Bank and atm facilities are available on the campus. Sports and events will be conducted for father's day, women's day, etc. Symposium will be conducted by every year by every department. In hostel, weekly ones non-vegetarian i.e mutton is provided, and on Sunday egg and fish is also pr...

reviews.review_heading: Staffs and faculty are good to interact with students.
reviews.review_text: Hostel food and hostel would be the worst, food schedule are repeated and not good, hostel room and Wi-Fi facility are not provided, cell phone Rae not allowed in hostel and watching and interfier students personal matter and no private individuals it be the worst.

reviews.review_heading: No graduation day in this college ever.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is very safe and good only for girls. In this generation there is no mobile phones are allowed in hostel also. Even they can't use keypad phone also. Wi-Fi facilities available but laptop not allowed inside campus. Library available but there is no importance given by faculty members.

reviews.review_heading: It is a safe college for girls, and it teaches how to survive.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are pretty good, but many were not able to use by students. The library is quite huge, but students have no enough time to go where 8 hours is not enough to complete class for the professors. The canteen is good and hygiene. Medical emergencies are good. I don't know about the sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Adhiparasakthi Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was not available in our college. Lab facilities were good, and classroom facilities were also good. The projector was also available in every classroom, which is very helpful for students to understand the concept. In the hostel, the food was good, and the infrastructure of our hostel was also very good.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides poor placements, pretty good sports and average teaching faculty.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are pretty good. The main problem is that they don't allow us to bring the mobile phone on the campus, and even for study purpose also. The college does not provide Wi-Fi facility. Labs are average. Sports facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Adhiparasakthi Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a good and good library, labs, etc. All the labs are clean and neat. We have good and more number of staff members in the hostel who take care of students like parents. The quality of the food served in the hostel is good. Medical, sports and games facilities are available in our college. Canteen and all other facilities are available for 24 hours in our college.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied by choosing this college as it didn't provide proper placements in 2017.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there is a wireless Wi-Fi facility. Our college has a separate block lab purpose with a minimum of 300 computers. There is a good infrastructure in the library, which I like. Our college has four blocks of buildings for classrooms with various departments, which was good.

reviews.review_heading: It does not provide placements. It has an average infrastructure and poor facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available at our college. The infrastructure of our college is average. Food served to the students is very poor. Medical facilities are available. The college does not give permission for games and sports. It is like the school not act like college. It does not help students for sports and games, and they only target overall studies only. Labs are available, but they are very poor for teaching.
